Les donn\u00e9es ont \u00e9t\u00e9 recueillies du 23 septembre au 16 octobre 2006 \u00e0 bord du NGCC Amundsen. Il y a eu 115 coul\u00e9es, associ\u00e9es \u00e0 79 stations oc\u00e9anographiques, dans la baie d'Hudson. \n\nLes param\u00e8tres suivants ont \u00e9t\u00e9 mesur\u00e9s\u00a0: temp\u00e9rature, conductivit\u00e9 et pression (avec un Sea-Bird SBE-9plus), oxyg\u00e8ne dissous (Sea-Bird SBE-43), pH (Sea-Bird SBE-18-I), fluorescence (fluorim\u00e8tre \u00e0 chlorophylle Seapoint), concentration en nitrate (Satlantic MBARI-ISUS 5T), transmittance (transmissom\u00e8tre Wetlabs C-Star), intensit\u00e9 lumineuse (PAR\u00a0; Biospherical Instruments QCP2300) et intensit\u00e9 lumineuse de surface (Spar\u00a0; Biospherical Instruments QCP2200). Des proc\u00e9dures de contr\u00f4le qualit\u00e9 ont \u00e9t\u00e9 appliqu\u00e9es aux donn\u00e9es. Les donn\u00e9es sont disponibles sur le Polar Data Catalogue et aupr\u00e8s du Service des donn\u00e9es sur l'environnement marin (MEDS) de P\u00eaches et Oc\u00e9ans Canada.\", \"edition-date\": \"\", \"publisher\": \"\", \"title\": \"ArcticNet 0502b - Donn\u00e9es CTD de la baie d'Hudson\", \"version\": \"1.0\", \"DOI\": \"10.5884/456\", \"language\": \"fr\", \"URL\": \"https://catalogue.cioos.ca/dataset/ca-cioos_ccin-456?local=fr\"}]
citation.en: [{\"type\": \"dataset\", \"id\": \"ca.cioos_ccin-456\", \"author\": [{\"given\": \"Gratton\", \"family\": \"Yves\"}, {\"given\": \"Guillot\", \"family\": \"Pascal\"}, {\"given\": \"Rail\", \"family\": \"Marie-Emmanuelle\"}, {\"given\": \"Simard\", \"family\": \"Annie\"}], \"issued\": [{\"date-parts\": [\"2024\", \"06\", \"26\"]}], \"abstract\": \"The CTD data was obtained during the 2005 ArcticNet scientific cruise #0502. The data were collected from September 23 to October 16, 2006, aboard the CCGS Amundsen. There were 115 casts, associated to 79 oceanographic stations, in the Hudson Bay. \n\nThe following parameters were measured: temperature, conductivity and pressure (with a Sea-Bird SBE-9plus), dissolved oxygen (Sea-Bird SBE-43), pH (Sea-Bird SBE-18-I), fluorescence (Seapoint chlorophyll fluorometer), nitrate concentration (Satlantic MBARI-ISUS 5T), transmittance (Wetlabs C-Star transmissometer), light intensity (PAR; Biospherical Instruments QCP2300) and surface light intensity (sPAR; Biospherical Instruments QCP2200). Quality control procedures were applied to the data. Data are available on the Polar Data Catalogue and at the Marine Environmental Data Service (MEDS) of Fisheries and Oceans Canada.\", \"edition-date\": \"\", \"publisher\": \"\", \"title\": \"ArcticNet 0502b - Hudson Bay CTD data\", \"version\": \"1.0\", \"DOI\": \"10.5884/456\", \"language\": \"en\", \"URL\": \"https://catalogue.cioos.ca/dataset/ca-cioos_ccin-456?local=en\"}]

      <mri:abstract xsi:type="lan:PT_FreeText_PropertyType">
        <gco:CharacterString>The CTD data was obtained during the 2005 ArcticNet scientific cruise #0502. The data were collected from September 23 to October 16, 2006, aboard the CCGS Amundsen. There were 115 casts, associated to 79 oceanographic stations, in the Hudson Bay. 

The following parameters were measured: temperature, conductivity and pressure (with a Sea-Bird SBE-9plus), dissolved oxygen (Sea-Bird SBE-43), pH (Sea-Bird SBE-18-I), fluorescence (Seapoint chlorophyll fluorometer), nitrate concentration (Satlantic MBARI-ISUS 5T), transmittance (Wetlabs C-Star transmissometer), light intensity (PAR; Biospherical Instruments QCP2300) and surface light intensity (sPAR; Biospherical Instruments QCP2200). Quality control procedures were applied to the data. Data are available on the Polar Data Catalogue and at the Marine Environmental Data Service (MEDS) of Fisheries and Oceans Canada.</gco:CharacterString>
        <lan:PT_FreeText>
          <lan:textGroup xlink:href="https://cioos.ca/translation_method" xlink:role="translation" xlink:title="text translated using the Amazon translate service / texte traduit à l'aide du service de traduction Amazon">
            <lan:LocalisedCharacterString locale="#fr">Les données CTD ont été obtenues lors de la croisière scientifique #0502 d'ArcticNet en 2005. Les données ont été recueillies du 23 septembre au 16 octobre 2006 à bord du NGCC Amundsen. Il y a eu 115 coulées, associées à 79 stations océanographiques, dans la baie d'Hudson. 

Les paramètres suivants ont été mesurés : température, conductivité et pression (avec un Sea-Bird SBE-9plus), oxygène dissous (Sea-Bird SBE-43), pH (Sea-Bird SBE-18-I), fluorescence (fluorimètre à chlorophylle Seapoint), concentration en nitrate (Satlantic MBARI-ISUS 5T), transmittance (transmissomètre Wetlabs C-Star), intensité lumineuse (PAR ; Biospherical Instruments QCP2300) et intensité lumineuse de surface (Spar ; Biospherical Instruments QCP2200). Des procédures de contrôle qualité ont été appliquées aux données. Les données sont disponibles sur le Polar Data Catalogue et auprès du Service des données sur l'environnement marin (MEDS) de Pêches et Océans Canada.</lan:LocalisedCharacterString>
          </lan:textGroup>
        </lan:PT_FreeText>
      </mri:abstract>

notes:
The CTD data was obtained during the 2005 ArcticNet scientific cruise #0502. The data were collected from September 23 to October 16, 2006, aboard the CCGS Amundsen. There were 115 casts, associated to 79 oceanographic stations, in the Hudson Bay. 

The following parameters were measured: temperature, conductivity and pressure (with a Sea-Bird SBE-9plus), dissolved oxygen (Sea-Bird SBE-43), pH (Sea-Bird SBE-18-I), fluorescence (Seapoint chlorophyll fluorometer), nitrate concentration (Satlantic MBARI-ISUS 5T), transmittance (Wetlabs C-Star transmissometer), light intensity (PAR; Biospherical Instruments QCP2300) and surface light intensity (sPAR; Biospherical Instruments QCP2200). Quality control procedures were applied to the data. Data are available on the Polar Data Catalogue and at the Marine Environmental Data Service (MEDS) of Fisheries and Oceans Canada.

The CTD data was obtained during the 2005 ArcticNet scientific cruise #0502. The data were collected from September 23 to October 16, 2006, aboard the CCGS Amundsen. There were 115 casts, associated to 79 oceanographic stations, in the Hudson Bay. 

The following parameters were measured: temperature, conductivity and pressure (with a Sea-Bird SBE-9plus), dissolved oxygen (Sea-Bird SBE-43), pH (Sea-Bird SBE-18-I), fluorescence (Seapoint chlorophyll fluorometer), nitrate concentration (Satlantic MBARI-ISUS 5T), transmittance (Wetlabs C-Star transmissometer), light intensity (PAR; Biospherical Instruments QCP2300) and surface light intensity (sPAR; Biospherical Instruments QCP2200). Quality control procedures were applied to the data. Data are available on the Polar Data Catalogue and at the Marine Environmental Data Service (MEDS) of Fisheries and Oceans Canada.
notes_translated.fr:
Les données CTD ont été obtenues lors de la croisière scientifique #0502 d'ArcticNet en 2005. Les données ont été recueillies du 23 septembre au 16 octobre 2006 à bord du NGCC Amundsen. Il y a eu 115 coulées, associées à 79 stations océanographiques, dans la baie d'Hudson. 

Les paramètres suivants ont été mesurés : température, conductivité et pression (avec un Sea-Bird SBE-9plus), oxygène dissous (Sea-Bird SBE-43), pH (Sea-Bird SBE-18-I), fluorescence (fluorimètre à chlorophylle Seapoint), concentration en nitrate (Satlantic MBARI-ISUS 5T), transmittance (transmissomètre Wetlabs C-Star), intensité lumineuse (PAR ; Biospherical Instruments QCP2300) et intensité lumineuse de surface (Spar ; Biospherical Instruments QCP2200). Des procédures de contrôle qualité ont été appliquées aux données. Les données sont disponibles sur le Polar Data Catalogue et auprès du Service des données sur l'environnement marin (MEDS) de Pêches et Océans Canada.
